x_fmla_c334ab_01.desc: Paid family leave should not depend on whether your employer happens to be generous.

x_fmla_c334ab_02.desc: A new parent should not have to choose between bonding with a baby and paying rent. What would a workable policy look like?

x_fmla_c334ab_03.desc: Small businesses need support too if paid family leave becomes a national standard.

x_fmla_c334ab_04.desc: Why does taking time off to care for a sick parent still feel like a luxury? Curious how others see this.

x_fmla_c334ab_05.desc: Parental leave is a workforce retention issue, not just a family issue.

x_fmla_c334ab_06.desc: Would a payroll-funded family leave program be fairer than leaving it to individual employers?

x_fmla_c334ab_07.desc: The U.S. has plenty of working parents. Why is guaranteed paid leave still so uneven?

x_fmla_c334ab_08.desc: Paid leave policies should cover adoptive parents and caregivers, not only new births.

x_fmla_c334ab_09.desc: Hourly workers are often least able to afford unpaid time off. That deserves attention.

x_fmla_c334ab_10.desc: What should the minimum paid parental leave period actually be: 6, 12, or more weeks? Thoughts?

x_fmla_c334ab_11.desc: If paid family leave is mandatory, how should very small employers manage staffing gaps?

x_fmla_c334ab_12.desc: A father taking parental leave should be normal, not treated as a career risk.

x_fmla_c334ab_13.desc: Caregiving emergencies do not arrive on a convenient schedule. Jobs should account for that.

x_fmla_c334ab_14.desc: Family leave without job protection is only half a solution. Anyone seen this handled well locally?

x_fmla_c334ab_15.desc: Is a national paid leave insurance model better than employer-funded benefits?

x_fmla_c334ab_16.desc: Some workers save every vacation day for a future medical emergency. That is not a leave policy.

x_fmla_c334ab_17.desc: Returning to work two weeks after childbirth should not be the default expectation.

x_fmla_c334ab_18.desc: Paid leave can help families, but we still need an honest conversation about who covers the cost.

x_fmla_c334ab_19.desc: Contract and gig workers belong in the paid family leave debate too.

x_fmla_c334ab_20.desc: Would guaranteed paid leave make you more likely to stay with an employer?
